decisions.reason: As our flagship GIS platform and a product line central to our strategic direction, it likely meets or exceeds aspiration levels through strong fit with our core capabilities and therefore merits continued support.

The field data capture software is close to our established offer and useful in integrated customer solutions, so with some organizational slack we would keep it unless demand clearly falls persistently below aspiration.
The search extension showed active version development and complements our web-map business, suggesting satisfactory enough performance relative to aspiration to remain on the market.
